objective: Assess the evidentiary impact of two competing witness accounts in a fictional criminal case

claims.text: Witness described leaving by the front entrance in interview A.
Witness described leaving by a side entrance at trial.
The exit account appears inconsistent on its face, subject to context review.

frames.thesis: Test whether the exit-route variance bears on the witness’s opportunity to observe.
frames.state_best_case: The two accounts describe different portions of one route; both can be true.

inferences.warrant: The accounts name potentially different passages; context determines materiality.
inferences.alternative: Both routes may have been used or questions differed.

frames.next_proof_step: Obtain full recordings and building plan; compare questions and context.
frames.remedy: Further investigation; make no unsupported legal remedy claim.
frames.risk: Difference may be immaterial after viewing context.
frames.weakest_link: Full contextual sequence not yet reviewed.
frames.falsifier: Complete record shows the two routes are sequential and compatible.
